title: Auditing Future-Memory Use in Point-in-Time Language Agents
title_zh: 对时点语言智能体中未来记忆使用的审计

paragraphs.en: Point-in-time (PIT) agents can recall post-cutoff facts even when their external evidence respects a historical cutoff. We examine whether this access predicts evidence gathering in 48 historical company-comparison tasks. Independent closed-book revenue probes identify the better-remembered company for each model on tasks with unequal recall, fixing the predicted direction before agent runs. We then compare paired runs with real or anonymized company identities while keeping external evidence PIT-valid. Both Qwen and DeepSeek recalled future facts, but neither supported the prespecified shift toward the better-remembered company. Qwen’s four allocation estimates on 28 unequal-recall tasks were negative, with descriptive intervals spanning zero. A prospective DeepSeek replication showed an inverse pattern across all four metrics on 20 such tasks, with intervals below zero. These estimates remained negative after each company, pair, and future-fact omission, and all four post-hoc max-T-adjusted sign-flip p-values were below .05. In a prospectively specified follow-up, explicit future facts produced small estimated shifts away from the supplied-fact company, with intervals spanning zero, while final choices shifted toward it. The mechanism behind the natural inverse pattern remains unresolved. These findings support separate assessments of memory accessibility, search allocation, and final outputs alongside cutoff checks on external evidence.

paragraphs.en: Point-in-time (PIT) agents simulate historical decisions using information available before a specified cutoff. In financial analysis and retrospective decision support, access to later documents can invalidate an evaluation even when the resulting answer appears plausible. Recent work on ex-ante inference and leakage-aware backtesting therefore examines the temporal validity of external evidence and model outputs ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Zhang and Stadie, 2026b ; Benhenda, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 时点（PIT）智能体利用指定截止时间之前可用的信息来模拟历史决策。 在金融分析和事后决策支持中，即使最终答案看似合理，获取后续文档也可能使评估失效。 因此，近期关于事前推断和泄露感知回测的研究考察了外部证据和模型输出的时间有效性（Liu et al., 2026；Zhang and Stadie, 2026b；Benhenda, 2026）。

paragraphs.en: The historical cutoff constrains retrieved evidence, while post-cutoff facts can remain accessible from the model’s parameters. Prior work has studied future-fact recall, identity masking in financial agents, and knowledge-aware search ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026b ; Feng et al., 2026 ) . We ask whether a model’s independently measured access to future facts predicts what it chooses to investigate when all external evidence is PIT-valid.
paragraphs.zh: 历史截断会限制检索到的证据，而截断之后的事实仍可能通过模型参数获取。 先前的研究探讨了未来事实的回忆、金融智能体中的身份掩码，以及知识感知搜索（Liu et al., 2026；Zhu et al., 2026b；Feng et al., 2026）。 我们想知道，模型独立测得的对未来事实的访问能力，能否预测当所有外部证据均符合PIT有效性时，它会选择调查哪些内容。

paragraphs.en: An agent may use a known future outcome to decide which company to investigate first while citing only pre-cutoff documents. It may also recall the outcome without changing its observable search behavior. Final answers and citation dates alone cannot distinguish these cases. We therefore examine the tool calls and evidence selections made during the investigation to test predictions about how future knowledge relates to the agent’s behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体可能利用一个已知的未来结果来决定先调查哪家公司，同时仅引用截止日之前的文档。 它也可以在不改变其可观察的搜索行为的情况下回忆该结果。 仅凭最终答案和引用日期无法区分这些情况。 因此，我们检查调查过程中使用的工具调用和证据选择，以检验关于未来知识如何影响智能体行为的预测。

paragraphs.en: We define Temporal Policy Contamination (TPC) as a systematic shift in observable information seeking in the direction predicted by independently measured access to post-cutoff facts. Our audit distinguishes three aspects of temporal integrity. Data integrity concerns when external evidence became available; policy integrity concerns whether future knowledge steers observable actions; output integrity concerns whether final claims and citations respect the historical cutoff.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将时间政策污染（TPC）定义为：可观察的信息寻求行为，朝着独立测量的“截止点后事实”访问数据所预测的方向发生系统性偏移。 我们的审计区分了时间完整性的三个方面。 数据完整性涉及外部证据何时变得可用；政策完整性涉及未来知识是否引导了可观察的行为；输出完整性则涉及最终论断和引用是否尊重历史截止点。

paragraphs.en: We apply this audit to 48 historical comparisons between public companies using Qwen ( QwenTeam, 2026 ) and DeepSeek ( DeepSeek-AI et al., 2026 ) . Each task has a Normal version with real company identities and an Anonymized version that replaces identifiers while preserving the underlying records, dates, numerical values, and outcome labels. Independent closed-book probes measure each model’s recall of the two companies’ future revenue. For tasks with unequal recall, we predict that revealing identities will shift evidence gathering toward the better-remembered company. We fix these predictions before collecting trajectories for each model. Four metrics measure allocation during early search, across all actions and decision batches, and among opened sources.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将此次审计应用于 48 组历史对比，这些对比涉及使用 Qwen（QwenTeam，2026）和 DeepSeek（DeepSeek-AI 等，2026）的上市公司。 每个任务都有一个包含真实公司身份的“正常版”，以及一个替换了标识符但保留了底层记录、日期、数值和结果标签的“匿名版”。 独立的闭卷测试用于衡量每个模型对这两家公司未来收入的记忆能力。 对于记忆能力不均衡的任务，我们预测，揭示公司身份会使证据收集更倾向于记忆更好的那家公司。 在收集每个模型的轨迹之前，我们会固定这些预测结果。 四项指标用于衡量早期搜索过程中的分配情况，涵盖所有行动和决策批次，以及已打开的信息源之间的分配。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are: (1) A directional audit that uses independent measurements of future-fact recall to specify predictions about search allocation before agent runs. (2) A paired PIT evaluation across two model families, with controlled identity presentation and batch-aware measures of evidence allocation. (3) Evidence that the prespecified positive allocation shift is unsupported in both models, together with a robust inverse allocation pattern in DeepSeek. (4) A semantic re-identification audit of anonymized evidence and a prospectively specified follow-up examining how explicit future facts affect search allocation and final choices.

paragraphs.en: Time-aware language models study changing facts ( Dhingra et al., 2022 ) , while contamination research develops retrieval-based and behavioral diagnostics ( Deng et al., 2024 ) . Prompted-cutoff tests show that earlier-date instructions do not reliably suppress causally related future knowledge ( Gao et al., 2025 ) . Recent methods address temporal leakage through matched controls and planted contamination ( Zhang and Stadie, 2026b ) and temporal enforcement ( Zhang and Stadie, 2026a ) . ExAnte combines cutoff-conditioned inference with memory checks to relate future knowledge to answers ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , while TimeSPEC attributes leaked claims to decisions ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: FinanceHarness evaluates PIT financial research with auditable citations ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) . Look-Ahead-Bench ( Benhenda, 2026 ) and Profit Mirage ( Li et al., 2025 ) study look-ahead bias and controlled contamination in financial tasks. KTD-Fin masks stock and date identities to evaluate financial-agent behavior ( Zhu et al., 2026b ) . We use paired tasks with real or anonymized company identities, preserving the dates and numerical content of the historical evidence. Closed-book probes measure access to future revenue facts before each model’s trajectories are collected. These measurements fix a model-specific prediction: revealing identities will shift the relative allocation of evidence toward the better-remembered company. We test this prediction against the agent’s observed search behavior.
paragraphs.zh: FinanceHarness 通过可审计的引用（Xiao 等，2026）对 PIT 金融研究进行评估。 Look-Ahead-Bench（Benhenda，2026）和 Profit Mirage（Li 等，2025）研究了金融任务中的前瞻偏差和受控污染问题。 KTD-Fin 通过遮蔽股票和日期身份来评估金融智能体的行为（Zhu 等，2026b）。 我们使用配对任务，其中公司身份为真实或匿名化形式，同时保留历史证据中的日期和数值内容。 闭卷探测在收集各模型轨迹之前，用于衡量模型对未来收入事实的访问情况。 这些测量确立了一个模型特定的预测：揭示身份将导致证据的相对分配向记忆更清晰的公司倾斜。 我们将这一预测与智能体观察到的搜索行为进行对比验证。

paragraphs.en: Each task asks which of two public companies will have higher future revenue growth, using evidence available by a historical cutoff. We construct the tasks from public filings in the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission’s (SEC) EDGAR system. Annual revenue observations come from the SEC XBRL Company Facts API and are checked against the corresponding annual statements; filing metadata come from the Submissions API ( U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 每个任务都会询问，在两家上市公司中，哪一家的未来收入增长会更高，并依据历史截止日之前的可用证据作出判断。我们利用美国证券交易委员会（SEC）EDGAR系统中的公开文件来构建这些任务。年度收入数据来自SEC的XBRL公司事实API，并与相应的年度财务报表进行核对；文件提交元数据则来自提交API（美国证券交易委员会，2024年）。

paragraphs.en: The frozen task pool contains 194 tasks covering 19 companies, 34 unordered company pairs, and target years FY2018–FY2024, with 126 unique future revenue facts. A deterministic stratified rule uses Qwen’s original two-probe memory scores and the historical heuristic prior’s agreement with the ground-truth winner to select 48 policy tasks covering all 19 companies, 32 pairs, and 77 of these facts. The task set was fixed before policy runs (Appendix A ). Appendix B gives the growth-label and cutoff rules, together with a complete worked task.

paragraphs.en: The corpus contains 453 historical 10-K/10-Q filings from the SEC EDGAR Archives, divided into 49,854 chunks. Normal and Anonymized are generated from the same canonical task and preserve cutoffs, labels, dates, document structure, and numerical content. Anonymized replaces identifiers through a task-local typed lexicon and uses a separate retrieval index. Audits found no known identifier residuals or numerical mismatches, and retrieval results matched on the checked fields for 288 fixed paired queries. A centralized availability gate enforces the cutoff for all model-visible content, including tool errors. Every assistant action and tool response is logged. Retrieval settings and tool interfaces are specified in Appendix B.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 该语料库包含来自美国证券交易委员会（SEC）EDGAR 档案库的 453 份历史 10-K/10-Q 文件，这些文件被划分为 49,854 个片段。 “正常版”和“匿名版”均基于相同的规范任务生成，并保留了截断点、标签、日期、文档结构和数值内容。 “匿名版”通过任务内部的类型化词汇表替换标识符，并使用独立的检索索引。 审核未发现任何已知的残留标识符或数值不匹配问题，并且在 288 个固定配对查询中，检索结果在已检查字段上完全一致。 一个集中式可用性网关对所有模型可见的内容（包括工具错误）强制执行截断限制。 所有助理操作和工具响应均被记录在日志中。 检索设置和工具接口详见附录 B.4。

paragraphs.en: The original audit used qwen3.8-27b 3 3 3 https://openrouter.ai/qwen/qwen3.8-27b . Each of the 126 future facts was tested with two fixed closed-book paraphrases, yielding 252 requests. A unit-aware scorer accepted answers within 5% relative error. We froze the resulting memory directions before running 48 Normal and 48 Anonymized trajectories. The confirmatory analysis uses these two-probe directions. paragraphs.en: For the prospective replication, we used deepseek-v4-flash-0731 4 4 4 https://openrouter.ai/deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731 . Five globally fixed closed-book probes per fact yielded 630 requests. The model-specific memory directions and 20-task asymmetric subset were frozen before any DeepSeek policy trajectory. We stopped the initial policy-v1 run after repeated failures to satisfy the text-only final-answer format. We then froze a structured adapter for post-investigation A/B submission that preserved the existing conversation. The full 96-run schedule was executed afresh under policy-v2, yielding 48 valid Normal and 48 valid Anonymized trajectories. Appendix L documents the runtime provenance. The probe templates and investigation and finalization messages appear in Appendix B.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 在拟进行的复现中，我们使用了 deepseek-v4-flash-0731 4 4 4 https://openrouter.ai/deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731 。 每个事实对应的五个全局固定闭卷探针共产生了 630 次请求。 在运行任何 DeepSeek 策略轨迹之前，模型特定的记忆指令和 20 任务非对称子集已被冻结。 由于多次未能满足仅文本的最终答案格式要求，我们停止了初始的 policy-v1 运行。 随后，我们冻结了一个结构化适配器，用于后续调查的 A/B 提交，同时保留了现有的对话内容。 在 policy-v2 下，完整的 96 次运行计划被重新执行，产生了 48 条有效的“正常”轨迹和 48 条有效的“匿名化”轨迹。 附录 L 记录了运行时的来源信息。 探针模板以及调查和最终确定消息见附录 B.3 。

paragraphs.en: We label calls and batches by the companies they target: company 1, company 2, both, or neither. K5 measures allocation over the first five available entity-directed batches. Overall action and batch asymmetry summarize allocation across the full investigation at the call and batch levels, respectively; opened-evidence asymmetry measures the sources the agent inspects. Memory-aligned metrics use each model’s frozen direction to orient allocation toward the better-remembered company. Secondary outcomes describe investigation length, tool use, parallelism, bilateralism, finalization, and accuracy. Appendix C defines the complete metric family, including P1 and K3.
paragraphs.zh: 我们根据智能体所针对的公司对通话和批次进行标记：公司 1、公司 2、两者或两者都不是。 K5 衡量在前五个可用的实体导向批次中的分配情况。 整体行动与批次的非对称性分别总结了整个调查在通话和批次层面的分配情况；已开启证据的非对称性则衡量智能体所检查的来源。 与记忆对齐的指标利用每个模型固定的方向，将分配导向记忆更清晰的公司。 次要结果描述了调查时长、工具使用、并行性、双边性、最终确定性和准确性。 附录 C 定义了完整的指标族，包括 P1 和 K3。

A post-hoc semantic re-identification audit tests whether models can recover company identities from three frozen Anonymized chunks per entity using standalone open- and closed-set probes (Appendix M ).

paragraphs.en: A prospectively specified follow-up tests whether explicit future facts alter evidence allocation. Each of the 48 tasks is run in two otherwise identical Anonymized conditions: one supplies Entity A’s true target-year revenue, and the other supplies Entity B’s. The prompt thus contains a post-cutoff fact, while retrieved evidence remains subject to the historical cutoff. The primary contrast is positive when allocation shifts away from the company whose fact is supplied. Appendix N gives the design and results.
paragraphs.zh: 一项前瞻性指定的后续测试将检验明确的未来事实是否会改变证据分配。 48项任务中的每一项都在两个其他方面完全相同的匿名化条件下运行：一个条件提供实体A在目标年份的真实收入，另一个则提供实体B的收入。 因此，提示语包含了一个截止日之后的事实，而检索到的证据仍受历史截止日的限制。 当证据分配从提供该事实的公司转向另一家公司时，主要对比结果为正值。 附录N给出了其设计和结果。

sents.en: A prospectively specified follow-up tests whether explicit future facts alter evidence allocation.

sents.en: Each of the 48 tasks is run in two otherwise identical Anonymized conditions: one supplies Entity A’s true target-year revenue, and the other supplies Entity B’s.

paragraphs.en: Both models recovered post-cutoff revenue facts in independent probes, yet neither supported the prespecified shift toward the better-remembered company. Qwen’s negative allocation estimates had intervals spanning zero; DeepSeek showed a robust inverse pattern across all four metrics. These findings challenge the hypothesized link between accessible future outcomes and preferential investigation of the associated company.
paragraphs.zh: 两种模型在独立探测中均恢复了截止日之后的收入事实，但两者均未支持预先设定的、偏向记忆更清晰公司的转变。 Qwen 的负向分配估计值区间跨越了零；DeepSeek 在所有四项指标中均表现出稳健的反向模式。 这些发现对可获取的未来结果与对相关公司优先调查之间假设的关联提出了质疑。

sents.en: Both models recovered post-cutoff revenue facts in independent probes, yet neither supported the prespecified shift toward the better-remembered company.
sents.zh: 两种模型在独立探测中均恢复了截止日之后的收入事实，但两者均未支持预先设定的、偏向记忆更清晰公司的转变。

sents.en: Qwen’s negative allocation estimates had intervals spanning zero; DeepSeek showed a robust inverse pattern across all four metrics.
sents.zh: Qwen 的负向分配估计值区间跨越了零；DeepSeek 在所有四项指标中均表现出稳健的反向模式。

sents.en: These findings challenge the hypothesized link between accessible future outcomes and preferential investigation of the associated company.
sents.zh: 这些发现对可获取的未来结果与对相关公司优先调查之间假设的关联提出了质疑。

paragraphs.en: Search substitution is a plausible explanation for DeepSeek’s inverse pattern: access to a future outcome could reduce further investigation of the associated company. The exploratory absolute-count decomposition is consistent with this account, showing greater withdrawal on the better-remembered side (Appendix K ). A prospectively specified follow-up supplied one company’s future revenue explicitly and yielded small shifts in the withdrawal direction, with all intervals spanning zero (Appendix N ). Company identities also remained recoverable from Anonymized text, and relative re-identification difficulty had inconsistent associations with the inverse allocation effects (Appendix M ). The mechanism behind the natural pattern remains unresolved.
paragraphs.zh: 搜索替代是 DeepSeek 反向模式的合理解释：对未来结果的获取可能会减少对该相关公司的进一步调查。 探索性的绝对计数分解与此解释一致，显示在记忆更清晰的一侧出现了更大的退出（附录 K）。 一项前瞻性指定的后续研究明确提供了某家公司的未来收入，并导致退出方向出现微小变化，所有区间均跨越零值（附录 N）。 从匿名化文本中仍然可以识别出公司身份，且相对重新识别的难度与反向分配效应之间没有一致的相关性（附录 M）。 自然模式背后的机制仍未得到解决。

paragraphs.en: Search effort and final decisions responded differently to the experimental conditions. Investigations were shorter in Normal for both models; accuracy was higher for Qwen and unchanged for DeepSeek. In Qwen’s Cue study, Cue–Anonymized contrasts shared the sign of Normal–Anonymized contrasts on five of six broad outcomes, while all four memory-aligned allocation intervals spanned zero. The explicit-fact follow-up shifted final choices toward the supplied-fact company while producing weak allocation responses.

paragraphs.en: These findings motivate PIT evaluations that combine source-availability checks, independent memory probes, trajectory analysis, and assessment of final claims and citations. Behavioral predictions should be fixed before agent runs, with broad investigation measures, memory-aligned allocation, and answer outcomes reported separately. For studies using anonymization as a historical control, semantic re-identification tests complement identifier checks by measuring the identity information retained in the content.
paragraphs.zh: 这些发现推动了 PIT 评估的发展，该评估结合了来源可用性检查、独立记忆探测、轨迹分析以及对最终主张和引用的评估。 行为预测应在智能体运行前固定下来，同时采用广泛的调查措施、与记忆对齐的资源分配，并分别报告答案结果。 对于使用匿名化作为历史对照的研究，语义再识别测试通过测量内容中保留的身份信息，对标识符检查起到补充作用。

paragraphs.en: We present a trajectory-based audit that combines independent future-memory probes with paired agent runs under PIT-valid external evidence. Both Qwen and DeepSeek recovered post-cutoff facts, yet neither supported the prespecified shift toward the better-remembered company. Qwen’s negative allocation estimates had intervals spanning zero, while DeepSeek showed a robust inverse allocation pattern. PIT evaluation should combine cutoff checks on external evidence with separate assessments of memory accessibility, search allocation, and final outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种基于轨迹的审计方法，该方法将独立的未来记忆探针与在 PIT 有效外部证据下运行的配对智能体相结合。 Qwen 和 DeepSeek 都恢复了截止点之后的事实，但两者都没有支持预设的、偏向于记忆更清晰公司的转变。 Qwen 的负分配估计值的置信区间跨越了零，而 DeepSeek 则表现出一种稳健的反向分配模式。 PIT 评估应将对外部证据的截止点检查与对记忆可访问性、搜索分配和最终输出的独立评估相结合。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments cover two model families served through Parasail as fp8 endpoints in a 48-task historical-finance setting. Both models were evaluated on the subset selected using Qwen’s original recall scores and the historical heuristic prior’s agreement with the ground-truth winner. The effect of deployment precision on memory accessibility remains unmeasured. The directional analyses use 28 Qwen tasks and 20 DeepSeek tasks. DeepSeek’s 28 tied tasks include 24 with memory scores of 1.0 / 1.0 1.0/1.0 , and their company and year composition differs from the asymmetric subset. These ties contribute little directional memory variation to the broader continuous analyses. Repeated companies, pairs, and future facts induce dependence across tasks. Bootstrap intervals are descriptive summaries of the evaluated task set; the post-hoc sign-flip analysis relies on task-level sign symmetry.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验涵盖了通过 Parasail 以 fp8 端点形式提供的两个模型家族，实验设置包含 48 个历史金融任务。 这两个模型均在基于 Qwen 原始召回分数以及历史启发式先验与真实获胜结果一致性的筛选子集上进行了评估。 部署精度对内存可访问性的影响尚未得到测量。 方向性分析使用了 28 个 Qwen 任务和 20 个 DeepSeek 任务。 DeepSeek 的 28 个并列任务中，有 24 个的内存分数为 1.0 / 1.0 1.0/1.0，且这些任务的公司和年份构成与不对称子集不同。 这些并列关系对更广泛的连续性分析贡献甚微的方向性内存变化。 重复出现公司、配对以及未来事实会在不同任务之间引入依赖性。 Bootstrap 置信区间是对所评估任务集的描述性总结；事后符号翻转分析则依赖于任务层面的符号对称性。

The directional re-identification strata are small, and associations with DeepSeek’s inverse pattern vary across metrics (Appendix M ). Residual identity recovery therefore remains a potential confound. The logs record investigation actions and final outputs; the internal use of remembered information remains unobserved.

paragraphs.en: DeepSeek’s structured finalization adapter was introduced after policy-v1 format failures and fixed before the complete policy-v2 rerun. The reported DeepSeek analyses use v2 trajectories, with evidence-free finalization excluded from allocation metrics (Appendix L ). The different finalization protocols limit cross-model comparisons of stopping behavior. Qwen frequently required forced finalization, and one Normal-arm finalization failure left 47 complete triplets in the separate Cue study. P1 is ceiling-limited, and K5 can miss low-prevalence injections in the synthetic sensitivity analysis (Appendix J ). The explicit-fact follow-up supplies future information in the prompt and yields small withdrawal estimates with intervals spanning zero (Appendix N ). The role of parametric future memory in the natural inverse pattern remains unresolved.

paragraphs.en: The selector uses Qwen’s original two-probe memory scores and four historical heuristics: latest revenue growth, mean growth over the two preceding years, growth acceleration, and the majority winner in earlier available outcomes for the pair. The majority of non-abstaining votes defines the prior direction, labeled consistent or conflicting by agreement with the ground-truth winner; balanced or absent votes give a tie. Prior strength is the absolute A–B vote difference divided by the number of non-abstaining votes, with bands weak ( ≤ .33 \leq.33 ), moderate ( .33 .33 – .67 .67 , endpoints excluded), strong ( ≥ .67 \geq.67 ), and missing when all heuristics abstain.
paragraphs.zh: 选择器使用 Qwen 原始的双探针记忆分数以及四个历史启发式指标：最新收入增长、过去两年平均增长、增长加速，以及该组合在早期可用结果中的多数获胜者。 非弃权投票的多数票决定了先验方向，通过与真实获胜者的一致性将其标记为一致或冲突；平衡或缺失的投票则导致平局。 先验强度是 A–B 投票的绝对差值除以非弃权投票数，其区间分为弱（≤ .33）、中等（.33 – .67，端点除外）、强（≥ .67），以及当所有启发式指标均弃权时标记为缺失。

paragraphs.en: Each task enters the first eligible stratum in this order: S1, M i ≥ .5 M_{i}\geq.5 with a conflicting prior; S2, M i ≥ .5 M_{i}\geq.5 with a consistent prior; S4, | m i ​ 1 − m i ​ 2 | ≥ .5 |m_{i1}-m_{i2}|\geq.5 and M i ≥ .25 M_{i}\geq.25 ; S3, M i < .5 M_{i}<.5 . Selection takes twelve tasks per stratum in that order. At each choice, candidates are ranked lexicographically by new pair, number of new companies, new target year, number of new future facts, then lower existing pair, company (maximum then total), and year counts. paragraphs.en: This is a historical factual-recall test, not a forecast.

paragraphs.zh: 仅回忆历史事实；不要预测或估计。

paragraphs.zh: {company_name} 在 {fiscal_year} 财年报告的年度总收入。

paragraphs.zh: 请回忆一个已报告的历史会计事实，不要进行预测。

paragraphs.en: Complete this historical factual-recall item from memory only.

paragraphs.zh: {company_name} — 财政年度 {fiscal_year} 的全年营收为：____ 十亿美元。

paragraphs.zh: 如果你无法从记忆中得知其历史价值，请回答“UNKNOWN”。不要进行估算。

paragraphs.en: Scoring compares the parsed, unit-normalized answer with the as-reported target revenue, with a 5% relative-error tolerance. paragraphs.en: The following system message accompanies the task message in the paired policy audits:

paragraphs.en: You are a historical financial-research agent. Use only the provided point-in-time historical environment and its tools. One assistant response is one decision batch, and multiple independent tool calls in one batch are allowed. Investigate Company A and Company B as needed, then call submit_answer exactly once with A or B and citations to opened evidence for both companies. The investigation horizon is 18 completed investigation decision batches; a separate 64-call safety fuse prevents runaway tool use. At the horizon you will receive an evidence-free finalization instruction. Do not browse externally, claim unavailable tools, or reveal private reasoning.

paragraphs.en: For each company, corpus selection uses filings whose report-period end falls in the inclusive interval from 730 days before the base fiscal-year end through that fiscal-year end. A selected filing must also pass the strict availability gate and be absent from the task’s excluded future source accessions. The allowed forms are 10-K, 10-K/A, 10-Q, and 10-Q/A. Extracted text blocks are grouped within sections and split at a maximum of 2,400 characters per source chunk, with no overlap. Anonymization preserves these chunk boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每家公司，语料库选择使用那些报告期结束日落在基准财年末前 730 天（含）至该财年末这一包含区间内的 filings。 所选的 filing 还必须通过严格的可用性筛选，且不能出现在任务中排除的未来来源新增数据中。 允许使用的表格类型为 10-K、10-K/A、10-Q 和 10-Q/A。 提取出的文本块按章节分组，每个来源分块的字符数最多为 2,400，且无重叠。 匿名化处理会保留这些分块的边界。

paragraphs.en: Normal and Anonymized each index their own visible chunks. Both use the same task-local identity normalizer on queries and indexed text. Query terms are deduplicated before scoring. Table A3 summarizes the retrieval settings.

paragraphs.en: A zero exposure sum makes normalized allocation undefined, including when no entity-attributed evidence was opened. P1 is undefined without an entity-directed batch, and memory-aligned measures are undefined for memory ties. Each paired contrast requires valid decisions and defined values in both conditions; undefined cells are omitted metric-wise without imputation. Parallel rate divides investigation batches containing more than one call by all investigation batches with an executed call. Bilateral rate divides bilateral batches by all entity-directed batches; the early version uses the available first K K entity-directed batches. Empty denominators are undefined. Other measures count investigation batches and calls, opened 10-K/10-Q evidence, finalization outcomes, and correct answers among valid decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 零暴露总和会使归一化分配变为未定义，包括在没有开启任何实体属性证据的情况下。 如果没有实体导向的批次，P1 是未定义的；对于内存关联项，与内存对齐的指标也是未定义的。 每对对比都需要在两种条件下都有有效的决策和明确的值；未定义的单元格在指标计算中会被省略，而不会进行插补。 并行率通过将包含多个调用的调查批次除以所有包含已执行调用的调查批次来计算。 双边率将双边批次除以所有实体导向的批次；早期版本使用可用的前 K 个实体导向批次。 空分母是未定义的。 其他指标会统计调查批次和调用、已开启的 10-K/10-Q 证据、最终化结果以及有效决策中的正确答案。

paragraphs.en: Batch results arrive before the next decision; call-array position does not establish an observation order within a batch. The protocol permits 18 completed investigation batches and uses a 64-call safety fuse; a batch that would exceed the fuse is rejected in full.
paragraphs.zh: 批次结果在下一个决策之前到达；调用数组的位置并未确定批次内的观察顺序。 该协议允许完成 18 个调查批次，并使用 64 次调用的安全保险丝；任何超出该保险丝限制的批次将被全部拒绝。

paragraphs.en: A valid submit_answer during investigation is a voluntary submission. Ordinary no-tool text or an invalid single submission triggers an evidence-free format-repair request. Reaching the horizon or fuse instead triggers an evidence-free final-choice request. At most two finalization attempts are allowed; failure to produce exact FINAL: A or FINAL: B text, or a valid submission, is recorded as a finalization failure. DeepSeek uses the choice adapter in Appendix L . Finalization exposes no new evidence and contributes neither allocation nor investigation-length counts. Investigation calls emitted with a submission remain logged but are excluded from pre-submission metrics: their results were unavailable when the answer was selected.
paragraphs.zh: 调查期间有效的 submit_answer 是一种自愿提交。 普通的无工具文本或无效的单一提交会触发一个无证据的格式修复请求。 相反，到达边界或保险丝则会触发一个无证据的最终选择请求。 最多允许两次最终确定尝试；若未能生成精确的 FINAL: A 或 FINAL: B 文本，或未生成有效的提交，则被记录为最终确定失败。 DeepSeek 使用了附录 L 中的选择适配器。 最终确定不会暴露任何新证据，也不会产生分配或调查长度计数。 伴随提交而发出的调查调用仍会被记录，但会排除在提交前指标之外：因为答案被选中时，这些调用的结果尚未可用。

paragraphs.en: Logs are append-only. Transport retries repeat the exact request and conversation state. Only technical failures permit trajectory reruns, numbered in successive generations. After checking schedule metadata, protocol, and generation continuity, analysis selects the sole highest-generation record without inspecting answers, correctness, or effect direction. Retry-only execution neither starts unrun entries nor retries completed, finalization-failed, or protocol-invalid trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 日志仅支持追加写入。 传输重试会重复发送完全相同请求并保留对话状态。 只有技术故障才允许重跑轨迹，其编号按连续代次递增。 在检查调度元数据、协议和生成连续性后，分析过程将选择唯一最高代次的记录，而无需查看答案、正确性或效果方向。 仅重试的执行流程既不会启动未运行的条目，也不会重试已完成、最终化失败或协议无效的轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Qwen’s generic identity familiarity score averages six closed-book probes per company: two each for name-to-ticker, ticker-to-name, and industry recognition. Historical financial familiarity averages two paraphrases for each of two annual revenue facts no later than FY2017. Across 19 companies, these comprise 114 identity and 76 historical requests (190 total). Identity familiarity has mean 0.7193, population SD 0.1627, and range 0.3333–1; historical familiarity has mean 0.4211, SD 0.4296, and range 0–1.

paragraphs.en: This post-hoc measurement check reuses the original policy trajectories; the primary analysis uses the original two-probe directions. Across 126 facts, two- and five-probe scores have Pearson/Spearman correlations 0.9077/0.9061; across 194 task-level means, the correlations are 0.9100/0.9051. Of the original 28 asymmetric policy tasks, 26 retain the same sign, one becomes tied, and one flips. Ten original ties become asymmetric, giving 37 tasks with nonzero five-probe directions. Table A4 reorients the unchanged raw N–A contrasts by these directions. Evidence uses 36 pairs because the Anonymized run of the FY2018 MSFT–NKE task opened no entity-attributed document or chunk, leaving its evidence ratio undefined. Every leave-one-template-out direction either agrees with the full five-probe sign or becomes tied; none reverses it.

paragraphs.en: This post-hoc analysis transforms evaluator-side batch labels on the fixed Anonymized trajectories from Qwen’s 28 originally asymmetric tasks. Independently for each entity-directed batch, probability α \alpha replaces its A-only, B-only, or bilateral label with the better-remembered entity’s unilateral label. Neutral labels, sequence lengths, and batch positions remain unchanged. The effect is the transformed-minus-original memory-aligned allocation, averaged over all 28 tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 这项事后分析将评估方在 Qwen 最初 28 个非对称任务中的匿名化轨迹批量标签进行了转换。 对于每个实体导向的批次，概率 α \alpha 会独立地将其仅 A、仅 B 或双边标签替换为记忆更清晰的实体的单边标签。 中性标签、序列长度和批次位置保持不变。 其效果是转换后与原始值之差在记忆对齐分配上的平均值，该平均值基于全部 28 个任务计算得出。

paragraphs.en: The homogeneous setting applies the transformation to every task. Each sparse replicate samples 8 of 28 tasks (the rounded 30% setting) or 14 of 28 (50%) uniformly without replacement and applies the transformation only to those tasks. Each cell uses 1,000 seeded transformations and 1,000 task bootstraps per transformation. The bootstrap resamples paired transformed/original task values and uses the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of their mean differences.
